claims.text: The package provides the agentic-kit command-line interface.
The package provides the agentic-kit-gui graphical entry point.
The website Python requirement is projected from pyproject.toml.
The website package version is projected from pyproject.toml.
The public command catalog is generated from the current command manifest and checked for synchronization.
agentic-kit workspace adopt inspects without writing.
agentic-kit workspace init previews changes before explicit execution.
The Kit can produce a structured successor handoff package for continuing work in another session or model.
The website command catalog is generated from the Kit's current command manifest.
